name: Dependency Inventory
description: Automated inventory of all dependencies: direct, transitive, native binaries, and dev dependencies.
purpose: Establish a complete, automated inventory of every dependency across the project so downstream security analysis (SBOM, vulnerability scanning, license compliance) has a trustworthy foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: All direct dependencies are cataloged with name, version, and source.
All transitive dependencies are resolved and cataloged for every package.
Native binaries (Electron, native modules, sidecars) are detected and cataloged.
Dev dependencies are separated from production dependencies.
Inventory is refreshed on every build and diffed against the previous state.
Inventory output is machine-readable (JSON) and human-readable (summary report).
